Placemaker.Feature.shops.Tooltip: Kiosks, food stands and ice cream near the entrances and along the paths.
Placemaker.Feature.streetShops.Tooltip: Leaves empty plots along the street for zoned buildings; nothing else is placed on them.
Placemaker.Feature.streetShops.Issue.NoF: Zoning: no edge of the area faces a road.
Placemaker.Feature.streetShops.Issue.Too: Zoning: the area is too small to give up plots along the street.
Placemaker.Shops.shopAmount.Tooltip: How much of the street frontage is left for zoning.
Placemaker.Shops.shopLayout.Tooltip: One continuous row of plots, or plots with lawn between them.
Placemaker.Shops.shopLayout.band.Tooltip: A continuous row of plots along the street, with gaps at the entrances.
Placemaker.Shops.shopLayout.pads.Tooltip: Small plots spaced along the street, with lawn reaching the street between them.
Placemaker.Shops.shopDepth.Tooltip: How deep the plots reach from the street (whole 8 m zone cells).
Placemaker.Feature.terrain.Tooltip: Reshapes the ground: mounds, hills, terraces, sunken or raised areas, berms. Blends back to the original ground at the edge. Permanent.
Placemaker.Terrain.Issue.Permanent: The terrain will be reshaped. This is permanent: removing the area later does not restore the ground.
Placemaker.Paint.Issue.Permanent: The ground texture will be painted. This is permanent: removing the area later does not undo it.
Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Name: Terrain shape
Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.shape.Tooltip: What to do with the ground. Every shape blends back to the original height at the edge.
Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.scale.Tooltip: Typical width of a mound or hill.
Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.maxSlope.Toolti: Steepest slope allowed between neighbouring spots.
Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.falloff.Tooltip: Distance over which the shape fades back to the original ground at the edge.
Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Issue.NoRoads: Berms: no road next to the area, so they follow the whole edge.
Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Issue.Nothing: The ground already has this shape: nothing to change.
Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Issue.RoughGrou: The ground here is already bumpy: no extra mounds or hills were added.
Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Issue.ScaledBac: The ground here is already uneven: the mounds or hills were made lower.
Placemaker.AddOn.Decals.Name: Decals
Placemaker.AddOn.Decals.ground.Tooltip: Where decals may go: automatic follows the theme (cracks on paving, leaves on lawns and paths).
Placemaker.AddOn.Decals.Issue.NoGround: Decals: no suitable ground for this theme here.
Placemaker.AddOn.Shops.Name: Food stands
Placemaker.AddOn.Shops.where.Tooltip: Near the entrances, spread along the paths, or along the edge.
Placemaker.AddOn.Shops.seating.Tooltip: Cafe tables (or picnic tables, or benches) beside each stand.
Placemaker.AddOn.Rocks.Name: Rocky outcrop
Placemaker.AddOn.Rocks.patch.Tooltip: Paints the terrain under each outcrop (permanent).
Placemaker.AddOn.Rocks.patchLayer.Toolti: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
Placemaker.AddOn.Restrooms.count.Tooltip: Exact number, or the most when placed by area.
Placemaker.AddOn.Restrooms.byArea.Toolti: One restroom per so many hectares, the first near an entrance.
Placemaker.Park.pathStyle.Tooltip: Character of the paths: garden walk, curvy, formal axes, lakeside loop, scenic route, riverside meander, figure-eight, spoke and ring, woodland trail, boardwalk loop, promenade avenue or a perimeter circuit.
Placemaker.Park.naturalGround.Tooltip: Paints a few patches of natural ground into the lawns (permanent).
Placemaker.Park.naturalLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
Placemaker.Park.playgroundPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the playground.
Placemaker.Park.picnicPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the picnic area.
Placemaker.Park.restroomsPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the restrooms.
Placemaker.Park.fountainPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the fountain.
Placemaker.Park.Issue.PathStyleFallback: This path style does not fit this area (or needs a pond or features); automatic paths were used instead.
Placemaker.Plaza.centerKind.Tooltip: Which kind of centrepiece the automatic choice uses.
Placemaker.Plaza.pattern.Tooltip: A second stone laid in bands: a grid, a line inside the border, or scattered large slabs.
Placemaker.Plaza.lighting.Tooltip: Feature lighting adds a ring of lamps round the centre and lamps along the edge.
Placemaker.Plaza.bollards.Tooltip: A row of bollards along the edges that face a road.
Placemaker.Plaza.levels.Tooltip: Terraces following the outline, a sunken or raised middle, or architectural levels on the square's axes: split level, a cascade of steps, a central podium or a sunken court (permanent terrain change).
Placemaker.Plaza.levelHeight.Tooltip: Total rise or drop across all levels.
Placemaker.Plaza.amphitheatre.Tooltip: A stage at the longest edge with rows of benches on arcs facing it.
Placemaker.Plaza.amphiRaise.Tooltip: Each row a little higher than the one in front (permanent terrain change).
Placemaker.Plaza.lawns.Tooltip: Share of the square covered by grass islands with a bush rim.
Placemaker.Plaza.beds.Tooltip: Clusters of flowerbeds near the edges.
Placemaker.Plaza.treeLayout.Tooltip: Trees round the edge, in a grid, or in groves.
Placemaker.Plaza.border.Tooltip: A strip of grass or gravel along the outline.
Placemaker.Plaza.pool.Tooltip: A long shallow pool along the main axis with benches beside it.
Placemaker.Plaza.realWater.Tooltip: Digs the pool and adds water, only on flat ground (permanent). Otherwise a water-look surface.
Placemaker.Plaza.jets.Tooltip: A splash pad of water jets, when such assets are installed.
Placemaker.Plaza.cafe.Tooltip: Groups of cafe tables near the edges.
Placemaker.Plaza.stalls.Tooltip: A grid of stalls facing the aisles.
Placemaker.Plaza.games.Tooltip: Chess or picnic tables in a corner.
Placemaker.Plaza.performance.Tooltip: A small stage with a few benches facing it.
Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.NoAmphitheatre: The amphitheatre does not fit here.
Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.NoPool: The reflecting pool does not fit here.
Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.PoolNotFlat: The ground is not flat enough for real water: the pool is a water-look surface.
Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.PoolPermanent: The pool digs into the terrain and adds water. This is permanent.
Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.NoRoadEdge: Bollards: no edge of the square faces a road.
Placemaker.Botanical.Name: Botanical garden
Placemaker.Botanical.theme.Tooltip: Each lawn becomes one collection: flower beds, shrubs, an arboretum or meadow.
Placemaker.Botanical.showBeds.Tooltip: Round and long beds of massed flowers, edged with low shrubs, beside the walks.
Placemaker.Botanical.pathBorders.Tooltip: Share of the shrubs planted as borders along the walks; the rest stand in clumps on the lawns.
Placemaker.Botanical.bedDensity.Tooltip: Planting per hectare in the collections.
Placemaker.Botanical.glasshouse.Tooltip: A glasshouse (or shelter) beside the main path.
Placemaker.Sports.Name: Sports park
Placemaker.DogPark.Name: Dog park
Placemaker.DogPark.runs.Tooltip: One run, or separate runs for big and small dogs.
Placemaker.DogPark.agility.Tooltip: Jumps, tunnels and weave poles in the big run.
Placemaker.DogPark.doubleGates.Tooltip: A small fenced entry pen at each gate so dogs cannot slip out.
Placemaker.DogPark.amenities.Tooltip: A dog bin by each gate and a drinking post.
Placemaker.Picnic.Name: Picnic grounds
Placemaker.Picnic.grills.Tooltip: A grill or fire pit at each picnic spot.
Placemaker.Picnic.openLawn.Tooltip: Share of the area kept as an open lawn in the middle.
Placemaker.Picnic.facilities.Tooltip: One restroom per 1.5 ha beside the paths.
Placemaker.Reserve.Name: Nature reserve
Placemaker.Reserve.treeDensity.Tooltip: Trees per hectare (forest is 200 or more).
Placemaker.Reserve.clearings.Tooltip: Open meadows in the woods, each with a bench.
Placemaker.Reserve.lookout.Tooltip: A lookout tower (or shelter) beside the trail at the highest point.
Placemaker.Formal.Name: Formal garden
Placemaker.Formal.allees.Tooltip: Rows of trees along the main axis.
Placemaker.Formal.Issue.NoParterres: No room for symmetric parterres in this outline.
Placemaker.Allotments.Name: Community garden
Placemaker.Allotments.sheds.Tooltip: A shed on every plot, shared sheds, or none.
Placemaker.Allotments.hub.Tooltip: A shelter with tables and a water tank by the entrance.
Placemaker.Allotments.Issue.NoPlots: No plots fit: try smaller plots.
Placemaker.Market.Name: Market square
Placemaker.Market.stalls.Tooltip: Stalls on a square of 0.4 ha. A bigger square gets more, in proportion (up to four times as many), so the market fills it.
Placemaker.Market.aisle.Tooltip: Width of the aisles between the stall rows.
Placemaker.Market.treeRing.Tooltip: Trees just inside the edge with benches between them.
Placemaker.Market.fill.Tooltip: The market fills the whole area, whatever its shape: a tree-lined market street between your entrances, a fountain where it meets the cross street, side streets, food courts at the crossings, planting islands and café groves in the blocks, and stalls right up to the edge.
Placemaker.Market.bollards.Tooltip: Bollards along the road edges (Big market: across each entrance, so people walk in and cars stay out).
Placemaker.Market.access.Tooltip: Click the edge where you want a way in, as in the parking tool. Nothing is added for you: the market is built only once you have placed at least one entrance. The market street runs between your two main entrances.
Placemaker.Market.Marker.Access.Tip: A way in for people: the walk in, bollards across it, bike racks and a food cart beside it.
Placemaker.Market.Marker.Entrance.Tip: A small car park at this edge of the market, cars in and out here. People walk from it into the market.
Placemaker.Market.Marker.Entry.Tip: A car park entered here. Put a way out next to it; on its own it is made two-way.
Placemaker.Market.Marker.Exit.Tip: A car park left here. Put a way in next to it; on its own it is made two-way.
Placemaker.Market.Marker.Alley.Tip: A service lane for the stall vans: a small pedestrian street from a new junction on the street a short way into the market.
Placemaker.Market.Marker.AlleyIn.Tip: A service lane for the stall vans (pedestrian streets are two-way, so it is the same as a driveway).
Placemaker.Market.Marker.AlleyOut.Tip: A service lane for the stall vans (pedestrian streets are two-way, so it is the same as a driveway).
Placemaker.Market.Reason.NeedsEntrance: Place at least one entrance on the edge: a gate for people, a car entrance or a driveway. Nothing is built until you do.
Placemaker.Market.groundPaint.Tooltip: Bare soil in the tree pits, lawn in the planting islands and worn ground where the gates meet the street (terrain paint: it stays after the market is removed).
Placemaker.Market.Issue.NoCarPark: A car entrance could not get a car park (no street in front of it, or no room there).
Placemaker.Market.Issue.NoStreet: A driveway needs a street in front of it and room behind it; this one was left out.
Placemaker.Skate.Name: Skate park
Placemaker.Skate.paved.Tooltip: How much of the area is the skate surface.
Placemaker.Cemetery.Name: Cemetery
Placemaker.Cemetery.chapel.Tooltip: A memorial or chapel near the crossing of the main paths.
Placemaker.Greenway.Name: Greenway
Placemaker.Greenway.restStops.Tooltip: Distance between rest stops (benches, bin, tree).
Placemaker.Greenway.secondPath.Tooltip: A narrow parallel path where the strip is wide enough.
Placemaker.Recipe.BotanicalGarden.Descri: Winding paths through themed collections: flower beds, shrubs, arboretum, meadow, and a glasshouse.
Placemaker.Recipe.SportsPark.Description: A designed sports park: one main field with a spectator terrace and clubhouse, courts clustered by sport, a promenade loop, groves and berms between the zones.
Placemaker.Recipe.DogPark.Description: Fenced runs with double gates, an agility course, benches and dog bins.
Placemaker.Recipe.PicnicGrounds.Descript: Picnic spots with tables and grills round an open lawn, shelters and restrooms.
Placemaker.Recipe.NatureReserve.Descript: Dense woodland with narrow trails, clearings and a lookout.
Placemaker.Recipe.FormalGarden.Descripti: Symmetric parterres with hedges, axes, allées and a fountain.
Placemaker.Recipe.CommunityGarden.Descri: Allotment plots with crops and sheds along lanes, and a communal hub.
Placemaker.Recipe.MarketSquare.Descripti: A paved square with market stalls, a tree ring and a centrepiece.
Placemaker.Recipe.SkatePark.Description: A skate area with ramps, benches round it and graffiti.
Placemaker.Recipe.CemeteryGrounds.Descri: Grave sections in rows with hedges, straight paths and a memorial.
Placemaker.Recipe.GreenwayPark.Descripti: A linear park: a long walk with planting and rest stops.
Placemaker.Botanical.moods.Tooltip: A few places in the garden get a mood of their own, read from the land: a rock garden on a knoll of boulders, a wildflower meadow, a bog garden in a wet hollow, a glade.
Placemaker.Botanical.moodGround.Tooltip: Lets those places cut and raise the ground (the gully, the knoll, the hollow). Terrain changes are permanent.
